title: Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam in Ten Days
alt: Longtail boats in the bay at Phi Phi island, Thailand
transport: Flights between the countries, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Phuket
stops.subtitle: Phuket and Phi Phi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small resort in the hills above Patong beach

activities.name: Phuket half day discovery tour
activities.description: The old town shophouses, the big Buddha on its hill and the Karon viewpoint over the three southern bays.

activities.name: Phi Phi island day trip with lunch
activities.match: Phi Phi Island Tour from Phuket
activities.description: A boat out to the Phi Phi islands for the cliffs at Maya Bay and Pileh lagoon, with snorkelling and lunch on board.

program.name: Phuket
program.description: Two nights above Patong, with a half day of the island and a boat day out to Phi Phi.

stops.name: Bangkok
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel on the eastern side of Bangkok

activities.name: Bangkok half day city tour
activities.description: The Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit and the Marble Temple, with the gem and silk showrooms on the way back.

program.name: Bangkok
program.description: A night in the Thai capital, with the Golden Buddha and the Marble Temple on arrival.

stops.name: Phnom Penh
stops.hotel: The Balé Phnom Penh by LifestyleRetreats
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 5★ · Five star retreat on the Mekong riverbank outside the city

activities.name: Phnom Penh city tour
activities.description: The Royal Palace and the Silver Pagoda, the national museum, and the Tuol Sleng memorial that records what the Khmer Rouge did here.

program.name: Phnom Penh
program.description: A night at a five star riverside retreat, with the palace, the museum and the memorial on arrival.

stops.name: Siem Reap
stops.subtitle: Tonle Sap and Angkor
stops.hotel_label: HARI Residence and Spa Siem Reap
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel with a pool, a short ride from the old market

activities.name: Tonle Sap lake boat ride
activities.match: Boat Ride Tour of Tonle Sap Lake
activities.description: A boat out onto the great lake, through a floating village of houses, schools and shops built on stilts and pontoons.

activities.name: Angkor Wat day tour
activities.description: Angkor Wat itself, the Bayon faces at Angkor Thom and the root covered ruins of Ta Prohm, with a guide for the full day.

program.name: Siem Reap
program.description: Two nights north, with the floating villages of Tonle Sap and a full day among the Angkor temples.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Hanoi full day city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day with a guide through the Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the old quarter, with lunch included.

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda
activities.description: A cycle ride through the rice fields to Bich Dong, a three tier pagoda built into the rock face.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: On to Vietnam for the last nights, with a full guided day of the capital and a day in Ninh Binh.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Three countries, five cities and a beach at the start. It is the sampler, and it works best if you treat the flights as part of the trip.
expert.tip: Keep hand luggage light. You have four internal flights and you will be glad not to wait at a belt in each airport.

summary: Ten days across three countries: two nights above Patong in Phuket with a Phi Phi island boat day, a night in Bangkok, a night at a five star riverside retreat in Phnom Penh, two in Siem Reap for Tonle Sap and Angkor, then three in Hanoi with a full city day and a Ninh Binh day trip.
included: Included: 9 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the Cambodian and Vietnamese hotels, including a five star riverside retreat; all flights between the countries; private transfers throughout; a Phuket half day tour; a Phi Phi island day trip with lunch; a Bangkok half day city tour; a Phnom Penh city tour; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour; a full day Hanoi city tour with lunch; a Ninh Binh day tour with a cycle ride to Bich Dong.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam visa fees; other lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
